The happy earth was spinning on its axis;
And the sun smiled from her golden crown,
While the air breathed a soft breath of peace
To the world that was at rest in her lap.

In the fields there rose an air-blue haze
Of spring blossoms round each blossoming tree;
On the hillside they were purple with bees.
And all nature was fair in the Springtime.

Kabul: Afghan forces killed 27 suspected insurgents in a raid on an insurgent training camp in southern Afghanistan overnight Sunday-Monday, security officials said Monday.

The Interior Ministry said that following intelligence reports of militants preparing to carry out attacks against government buildings or foreign troops in Kandahar province, police raided the compound late Sunday night.

Police cordoned off the area before entering the building at dawn and killing 19 men who were believed to be members of Taliban and al Qaeda sleeper cells, said spokesman Najib Danish.

Eight other insurgents had been arrested during the operation, he added.

author: buchanan
text:
Fellow-Citizens of the Senate and House of Representatives:
The President has transmitted to Congress a message containing propositions in respect to our relations with Mexico which are so important as to require an early determination by both Houses. It is not my intention at this time to enter into any discussion of those propositions; but I deem it proper, in obedience to the request of the President, to lay before you that part of his communication relating to our foreign relations generally, with some such remarks as may be necessary to prepare your minds for the consideration of the subject matter in dispute between us and Mexico.

Dear Students,

I am sure most students would agree that they feel better prepared for exams if they studied more often during the term rather than cramming 24 hours before an exam. However, many don’t realize how important studying regularly is and how it affects test scores and performance on other assignments (as well as grades).

Ilocano language is spoken in northern Philippines. Ilocanos are farmers. They cultivate rice as their staple food crop. The land they live on was once part of a vast forest that stretched from China to Thailand. It covered an area 12 times the size of Great Britain (480,000 square miles). Today it is mostly cleared, with small patches of rainforest left along river valleys. As I read this letter sent by James Monroe to Congress (1839) on behalf of President Martin Van Buren, it appears that he was concerned about America’s foreign affairs. He wrote about how he felt America should treat other countries around us as well as different cultures within the United states. He talked about how we need to let go of the past and create something better for ourselves.
